subject: GreenPeak access orchestration & service account mapping
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@greenpeak.com>, Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@greenpeak.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GreenPeak access orchestration & service account mapping

Hi Alex / Paul —

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier this week. Before we start the engineering tasks, I want to align on access controls so our implementation sprint doesn't hit surprises. Below are the concrete items we need from GreenPeak and notes on our side so we can build the SCIM/SSO and service-account model in one pass.

Request list (please reply inline where possible):
- SSO: IdP provider + whether you will host metadata or want us to provide SP metadata (we support SAML2 / Okta / Azure AD). If Okta, please share org URL and an integration admin contact.
- SCIM: desired canonical attributes (we typically map email, displayName, groups, employeeId, title). Call out any custom attributes (e.g., partner_id).
- IP allowlist: public egress ranges that need access to your onboarding endpoints, and the set of IPs you’ll allow for our webhook callbacks.
- Service accounts: do you want a single multi-tenant integration account, or environment-scoped service accounts (dev/stage/prod)? Also state least-privilege scopes you require.
- Org policies: session timeout, SSO enforcement date, data residency constraints, and approved approvers for onboarding changes.

Attachments: I’m attaching our onboarding template and a blank service-account mapping workbook (greenpeak-sa-mapping.xlsx) for you to fill.

Proposed timeline: once we have the items above, our onboarding sprint (2 engineers + 1 CS) estimates 7 business days for SAML/SCIM + 3 days for IP/service-account validation.

Next step: Can you confirm who will own the IdP integration (name + email) and populate the attached sheet by EOD Tue, 4 May? If it helps we can schedule a 30-min mapping call next week.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@greenpeak.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@greenpeak.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GreenPeak access orchestration & service account mapping

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the checklist, this is super helpful. Quick answers inline: 
- SSO: We use Okta (greenpeak.okta.com). I (Alex) will be the admin contact; you can reach me at alex.wu@greenpeak.com. We prefer to host metadata but happy to accept SP metadata if that simplifies testing.
- SCIM: Core attributes: userName (email), name (given/family), groups, employeeNumber (maps to employeeId), title. We also surface department and managerId as optional.
- IP allowlist: Our security team publishes ranges. Current egress we expect from our systems are 54.219.0.0/16 and 18.204.0.0/15 (these are our public connectors). For webhook callbacks allowlist IPs, please use 34.198.12.22/32 and 34.198.12.23/32 for initial testing; we can update to a /24 once validated.
- Service accounts: We strongly prefer per-environment scoped service accounts (dev/stage/prod) with minimal scopes. For prod, token rotation every 90 days is required.
- Org policies: SSO enforcement planned for 2027-05-31; session inactivity 60 minutes. Data residency: US only. Approvers: Paul (paul.jensen@greenpeak.com) and myself.

Attached is a partially completed SA mapping sheet (I filled prod requirements). Let me know if you want a 30-min call next Tue (4 May) 10:00am PT.

Cheers,
Alex
Senior Engineering Manager — Integrations
GreenPeak
Attachment: greenpeak-sa-mapping.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@greenpeak.com>, Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@greenpeak.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GreenPeak access orchestration & service account mapping

Thanks Alex — this is great and gives us everything to start. A couple notes and the draft plan below.

Immediate actions (owners):
- GreenPeak: confirm the two callback IPs after your security review (Alex / Paul) — due Tue 4 May EOD.
- Redwood CS (Monica): validate SCIM attribute mapping and confirm we can accommodate managerId as optional.
- Redwood Eng (Jordan): prepare SP metadata and test tenant for Okta SAML (Jordan will provision test tenant once we have metadata).

Draft schedule: 
- Tue 4 May: GreenPeak fills SA mapping sheet + confirm IPs (Alex).
- Wed 5 May: Redwood provisions SP metadata + test tenant (Jordan).
- Thu 6 May: Joint SCIM attribute verification call (30m).
- Mon 10 May: Run end-to-end test: SAML sign-on, SCIM sync (groups + manager), webhook callback validation.

Attachments: I attached the Redwood onboarding template (redwood-onboard-template.pdf) and re-attached your SA mapping. Please use the mapping sheet to indicate the exact SCIM attribute names and whether they are read-only.

If the timeline works, Jordan will follow up with the SP metadata by Wed morning and Monica will send a pre-test checklist. Otherwise propose alternate windows.
